# Adelin Diac

> Founder & Software Engineer. I build cool things.

Adelin Diac is a founder and software engineer based in Ireland. He is the Co-Founder & CEO of CallCrewAI — the autopilot for trades & field services, using AI voice assistants to help construction and field service companies automate their operations.

## Background

- Co-Founder & CEO at CallCrewAI (Sep 2025 – Present)
- Site Reliability Engineer at Susquehanna International Group (Apr 2025 – Sep 2025)
- Software Engineer at IBM (Sep 2024 – Apr 2025)
- Founder of MH1 Tutors — 400+ student-tutor connections (Mar 2023 – Jun 2024)
- Software Engineer Intern at Hereworks (Jun 2022 – Sep 2023)
- Founded a maths tutoring business, taught 100+ students (Oct 2020 – Mar 2023)
- B.Eng in Mechatronic Engineering from Dublin City University — graduated #1 in class, 1st class honours, Dean's Honours List (2020 – 2024)

## Key Achievements

- #1 Place Graduate — top of class, only student to achieve 1st class honours
- Dean's Honors List — top 5% of graduates in DCU Faculty of Engineering & Computing
- Founders Weekend Winner at PorterShed (NDRC Galway) — AI voice assistant for construction
- €10M+ projected impact from analytics system built during Hereworks internship
- IBM internal AI Hackathon Winner — meeting-summary AI agent for Teams calls
- First student in secondary school to exceed 600 CAO points (max 625)
